evidence.quote: 缺少真工蚁的低等白蚁在发育到成虫的过程中，前胸腺经历了相当规律的生长过程
evidence.locator: 001-200.txt 第 383 行（卷内页码未标）
evidence.note: 支撑：低等白蚁缺少真工蚁、与白蚁科分野的生理背景（v5 段 700–702）；本书列于文末文献。

evidence.quote: 胫节的边缘常生有1排硬刺(spine),在胫节 的末端有2或3枚胫节刺，称为端距(tibialspur)
evidence.note: 支撑：tibial spur=端距 的显式定义；据此定规范译名「端距/端距式」，改「胫距/胫距式」。OCR 原样（跑节=跗节）。

evidence.quote: 乳白蚁的雄性有1对针突，雌性缺针突。第10腹片中间分开，在两侧缘上有尾须
evidence.note: 支撑：针突=stylus 旧译；据此统一为「刺突」。

evidence.quote: 针突（styli）短，不超过腹部
evidence.note: 支撑：针突=styli 旧译；据此统一为「刺突」。
支撑：胫距=端距 的异译；据此改「端距式」。

evidence.quote: 等翅目最早定名的属是白蚁属Termes,由林奈于1758年定名。早期定名的属还有木白蚁属Kalotermes、草白蚁属Hodotermes、鼻白蚁属Rhinotermes、洞白蚁属、胄白蚁属，它们均由Hagen命名，前3属命名于1853年，后2属命名于1858年。
evidence.note: 支撑：Termes 1758、Kalotermes/Hodotermes/Rhinotermes 1853 等命名史

evidence.quote: 广义的拟工蚁或假工蚁，定义为个体作为一种 功能分类完成工作，而其余的发展灵活。其区分于真工蚁的后期特征是产生了早期的 和不可逆转的发展分支，失去了继续分化为有翅蚁的可能。
evidence.locator: 第 6 章 Roisin & Korb / 101-200.txt 第 371 行
evidence.note: 支撑：真工蚁定义（v5 段 700）；引文中的空格为文库 OCR 原样。

evidence.quote: 达尔文澳白蚁Mastotermes darwiniensis的发育图中存在工蚁和若蚁两条支路
evidence.note: 支撑：澳白蚁科有真工蚁（v5 段 700）

evidence.quote: 没有真 工蚁分化途径，因此个体被划分为广义的拟工蚁。
evidence.note: 支撑：原鼻白蚁属（沙白蚁科）无真工蚁（v5 段 700）

evidence.quote: 杆白蚁属的品级体系几乎是未知的
evidence.note: 支撑：杆白蚁属品级未知（v5 段 700）

evidence.quote: 从系统发育来说，兵蚁是所有生活白蚁的祖先的基础血统一次进化而来。
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁单次起源（v5 段 706）

evidence.quote: 存在所谓的兵蚁源繁殖蚁(Myles 1986),更恰当的称呼是类兵 蚁补充繁殖蚁(Roisin 2000)
evidence.note: 支撑：类兵蚁补充繁殖蚁（v5 段 706）

evidence.quote: 这些是否为真工蚁尚不能确定
evidence.note: 支撑：沙白蚁属真工蚁未定（v5 段 700）

evidence.quote: 成熟雄 虫通常在第九腹板的末端具有一对针突(styli)(不分节)，但依据种类不同有所变化。
evidence.note: 支撑：针突(styli)=stylus 旧译；据此统一为「刺突」。

evidence.quote: 前翅鳞显著大于后翅鳞，而白蚁科的前、后翅鳞约为同等大小
evidence.note: 支撑：翅鳞前后比例（v5 形态篇翅节）

evidence.quote: 草白蚁科的跗节分离不完整，由腹面看为5节，由背面看仅4节。
evidence.note: 支撑：跗节分节（v5 段 226）；该书“草白蚁科”为旧广义，含原白蚁属。

evidence.quote: 每侧卵巢的卵巢小管数仅7—10条
evidence.locator: 001-100.txt 第 309 行（雌性生殖系统）
evidence.note: 支撑：卵巢管数随类群变化（v5 段 511）

evidence.quote: 还有不少种类，同一巢蚁的工蚁，其体形大小有很大区别，具有两型或三型，土垅大白蚁 Macrotermes annandalei (Silvestri)、黄翅大白蚁 M. barneyi Light 同一群休内都有大工蚁和小工蚁之分
evidence.locator: 001-100.txt 第 344 行（非生殖型·工蚁品级）
evidence.note: 支撑：二型/多型工蚁见于 Macrotermes（土垅大白蚁、黄翅大白蚁），而非 Termes。OCR 原文『同一群休内』＝『同一群体内』。

evidence.quote: 兵蚁一般只有一类，但是在某些类群中，如大白蚁属 Macrotermes、小白蚁属 Microtermes 等，其兵蚁有大兵蚁和小兵蚁之分。
evidence.locator: 001-100.txt 第 349 行（非生殖型·兵蚁品级）
evidence.note: 支撑：二型兵蚁见于 Macrotermes、Microtermes，而非 Termes。

evidence.quote: 兵蚁  通常有大、小两类体形，或大、中、 小三类体形。
evidence.note: 支撑：大白蚁属 Macrotermes 兵蚁通常二型、部分三型——站点描述已正确

evidence.quote: 图360 箕头大白蚁 M. declivatus 大兵：1.头及胸背板背面；4.头侧面；7.后颏；10.上颚；13.触角；中兵：2.头及胸背板背面；5.头侧面；8.后颏；11.上颚；14.触角；小兵：3.头及胸背板背面；6.头侧面；9.后颏；12.上颚；15.触角。(仿朱世模)
evidence.note: 支撑：箕头大白蚁 Macrotermes declivatus 为三型兵蚁种（大兵+中兵+小兵）

evidence.quote:
大兵蚁  头黄色，象鼻黄色带褐。 头 、胸部几无毛，鼻端具数根毛， 腹部背板被少
量细短毛。
头宽大于长，宽圆形，两侧圆形凸出，后缘宽圆，触角13节，第3节2倍或甚长 于2节，上颚尖刺极小。前胸背板马鞍状，前半部直立。胫节距2:2:2。跗节4节。
小兵蚁  色泽、毛序、头型均似大兵蚁。 上颚尖刺极小，多数仅呈点状，触角12 节。胫距2:2:2。跗节4节。
evidence.note: 支撑：华象白蚁属 Sinonasutitermes 属级大兵蚁+小兵蚁（二型）——站点 diagnosis「兵蚁二型（个别种三型）」的前半依据
支撑：华象白蚁属分种检索表首条「兵蚁大、中、小三型」——个别种三型的检索依据

evidence.quote:
中兵蚁 体色稍淡。头扁圆形，宽大于长。鼻粗圆锥状，短于头长，侧观鼻伸向
前，端部低于头顶，鼻基似拱起，鼻夹角大于105°。触角13节，第2节最短，约为第
3 节之半，第4节稍长于2节。前胸背板前缘凹切甚浅。
小兵蚁 头长圆形，长大于宽，鼻短于头长，侧观鼻平伸向前，端部稍低于头顶，
鼻基平，鼻夹角约100°。触角12节，第2节最短，第3节1.5倍长于2节，第4节稍长 于 3 节 。前胸背板前后缘近平直(图526)。
evidence.note: 支撑：奇异华象白蚁 S. admirabilis 中兵蚁+小兵蚁（连同 927–930 大兵蚁成三型）

evidence.quote:
图534  三型华象白蚁 S.    trimorthus
兵蚁：1—3.大、中、小兵蚁头背面； 4—6 . 大 、中、小兵蚁头侧面； 7--9.大、中、小兵蚁上
颚；10 —12.大、中、小兵蚁前胸背板；13—15.大、中、小兵蚁触角；
工蚁：16.上颚。(仿李桂祥等)
evidence.note: 支撑：三型华象白蚁 S. trimorphus 图 534 大、中、小兵蚁（三型）

evidence.quote: 工蚁  单型或二型。头具稀疏毛，宽圆形，触角窝后部最宽，囟圆形凹坑，位于T 形缝交叉点正后方，后唇基隆起， 触角14 — 15节。 前胸背板较宽，前缘中央凹入。后 足胫节较短。
evidence.note: 支撑：夏氏白蚁属 Xiaitermes 工蚁「单型或二型」；原站点只写工蚁，漏了兵蚁品级

evidence.quote:
1. 兵蚁大小二型，大兵蚁头长连象鼻1 .96—2.10(2.03)mm,   头长不连鼻1.10 —1.25(1.16)mm,    头 宽1.24—1.45(1.41)mm,  前胸背板宽0.67—0.76(0.72)mm  …   … 藓县夏氏白蚁 X.yinxianensis
2. 兵蚁单型，头长连象鼻1.72—1.90(1.80)     mm,   头长不连鼻0.94—1.05(0.98)mm, 头宽1.04—1.12 (1.08)mm,       前胸背板宽0.55—0.59(0.57)mm …     …       … … … ·      天台夏氏白蚁 X.    tiantaiensis
evidence.note: 支撑：夏氏白蚁属分种检索表——鄞县夏氏白蚁 yinxianensis 兵蚁大小二型、天台夏氏白蚁 tiantaiensis 兵蚁单型（OCR「藓县」=「鄞县」）。据此站点 soldier 补「兵蚁单型或二型」
支撑：鄞县夏氏白蚁图 489 大兵蚁+小兵蚁+大工蚁+小工蚁（兵蚁二型、工蚁二型）

evidence.quote:
兵蚁具二态：
大兵  头形较短宽，似方形，囟圆形，开口位于两触角窝之间，孔口前方具纵沟伸 达唇端；上颚强壮，粗或扁宽，前部较内弯，左上颚内缘具2枚大齿，右上颚内缘具2 枚齿(或第2枚缘齿能见稍突出的齿痕迹)。上唇颇短宽，两侧近中部稍突出，呈六边 形，前沿中央略凹，端部具透明区，沿前缘具一排刷状短毛。触角16—17节。
小兵  头形稍狭长，凶圆形，开 口 ，位 于触角窝之间，孔口前方具纵沟伸至唇端； 上颚较细直，仅端部略弯，左上颚内缘具2枚缘齿，右上颚内缘具1枚缘齿；上唇较狭  长，两侧中部略收缩呈腰，端部透明区中央略凹，凹口两侧呈圆弧形两叶，沿前缘具一  排刷状短毛，唇端伸过或伸达近颚端；触角13—16节。
evidence.note: 支撑：棘白蚁属 Schedorhinotermes 属级「兵蚁具二态」大兵+小兵（二型，站点正确）。OCR「凶圆形」=「囟圆形」

evidence.quote: 胫节侧缘常生一列硬刺，末端有2—3枚端距
evidence.note: 支撑：端距=规范译名；据此改「胫距」。同段末「木白蚁科有些种类有爪间突」支撑 arolium=爪间突。

evidence.quote: 在一些原始的白蚁雄虫中，其第9腹板 后缘中部常有1对不分节的刺突
evidence.note: 支撑：刺突=stylus 规范译名；据此改「针突/腹刺」。

evidence.quote: 第7腹板(或称下 阴片，生殖板或亚生殖板等)延长
evidence.note: 支撑：下阴片/生殖板/亚生殖板 同物异名；据此 subgenital plate=下阴片，改「生殖板」。

evidence.quote: 胫节有3个端距，跗节4节。
evidence.note: 支撑：端距=胫节末端距（「胫节有3个端距」）；据此改「胫距」。

evidence.quote: 胫距式：3:3:3;跗节4节。
evidence.note: 支撑：胫距式=端距式 异译；据此改「端距式」。

evidence.quote: 雄虫具单节腹刺，雌虫缺腹刺，尾须2节。
evidence.note: 支撑：腹刺=stylus 旧译；据此统一为「刺突」。

evidence.quote: all species of this clade have a true worker caste (as in Mastotermitidae, Hodotermitidae, and Rhinotermitidae sensu novo) and typically live in large colonies.
evidence.note: 支撑：Geoisoptera 全部种类具真工蚁（v5 段 700）

evidence.quote: seven family-level monophyletic lineages, including the Heterotermitidae Froggatt, Psammotermitidae Holmgren, and Termitogetonidae Holmgren, raised from subfamilial rank.
evidence.note: 支撑：新等翅类七科、沙白蚁科/寡脉白蚁科等由亚科提升（v5 分类叙述）

evidence.quote: group relationship with the subsocial Cryptocercus wood roaches
evidence.note: 支撑：白蚁与隐尾蠊互为姐妹群（v5 段 828）

evidence.quote: We restrict Rhinotermitidae to Acorhinotermes, Dolichorhinotermes, Parrhinotermes, Rhinotermes, and Schedorhinotermes, the five genera composing the Rhinotermitinae (i.e., Rhinotermitidae Froggatt, sensu novo).
evidence.note: 支撑：鼻白蚁科 sensu novo 仅保留五属

evidence.quote: we redefine Termitinae Latreille sensu novo and restrict it to Termes and related genera, which unambiguously formed a monophyletic group in all our analyses
evidence.note: 支撑：白蚁亚科收窄到 Termes 及其近缘属

evidence.quote: we propose to erect six monophyletic lineages to new subfamilies in Termitidae: Crepititermitinae subfam. nov., Cylindrotermitinae subfam. nov.
evidence.note: 支撑：白蚁科新增六个亚科（摘录只列前两个）

evidence.quote: Our comprehensive phylogenetic analyses unambiguously identified four neoisopteran family-level clades diverging alongside the Serritermitidae and Termitidae: the Heterotermitidae (Coptotermes, Heterotermes, and Reticulitermes), Psammotermitidae (Psammotermes and Prorhinotermes), Termitogetonidae (Termitogeton), and Rhinotermitidae
evidence.note: 支撑：广义鼻白蚁科拆成四个科级支系

evidence.quote: The number of subfamilies within the Termitidae is expanded given that the current Termitinae are demonstrably polyphyletic.
evidence.note: 支撑：旧白蚁亚科为多系，白蚁科亚科数增加

authors: Bourguignon T., Šobotník J., Sillam-Dussès D., Jiroš P., Hanus R., Roisin Y., Miura T.

evidence.quote: Beside numerous pluripotent pseudergates, constituting the main work force, some larger non-feeding apterous immatures, also occur. These individuals are unable to proceed to the winged imago stage, but store large amounts of fat and also give rise to large soldiers.
evidence.note: 支撑：沙白蚁属主劳力为多能拟工蚁，另有一支大型无翅不育个体

evidence.quote: The caste system of P. hybostoma is essentially linear, as in other basal Rhinotermitidae, but is distinguished by the late bifurcation leading to large apterous immatures.
evidence.note: 支撑：沙白蚁属品级体系基本为线性，晚期分叉产生大型无翅个体

evidence.quote: Because these large worker-like individuals deviate late and do not perform worker tasks, they cannot be considered homologous to the true workers of Termitidae and advanced Rhinotermitidae, but they provide a novel example of the evolution of sterile immatures in termites.
evidence.note: 支撑：这些大型个体不构成真工蚁——分叉晚、不承担工蚁劳作

evidence.quote: 本文記述了在中国南部发現的下列二十一个新种。其中有＊号者是作者参加中苏合作云南生物考察队时所采集到的部分材料。

evidence.note: 支撑：本文性质（新种记述）与标本来源（中苏合作云南生物考察队）；21 个新种的总数

evidence.quote: 在集中起来的标本中包括了許多在国内未經記載的种类，經整理后发现 21 个新种。其中有 3 种属于木白蚁科 Kalotermitidae，3 种属于鼻白蚁科 Rhinotermitidae，15 种属于白蚁科 Termitidae。
evidence.locator: p.168 第 1 段（PDF 第 2 页）
evidence.note: 支撑：新种数与科级分配（3+3+15=21），以及 1958 年华南热带作物科学研究所标本移交后整理所得

evidence.quote: Paracurvitermes has a broader head capsule with well developed conical and shorter frontal tube than
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae

sources.title: Species groups in the genus Cubitermes (Isoptera: Termitidae) defined on the basis of enteric valve morphology
sources.retrieved_via: PyMuPDF text extraction from publisher PDF

evidence.quote: Head capsule: Well sclerotised and generally dark, C6–C8 (however, long preserved imagines can become as clear as C4, as already mentioned by Williams 1966); fontanelle concolorous with or paler than head capsule (one to five palette levels paler)
evidence.note: 支撑：Cubitermes 有翅成虫头壳与额孔颜色

evidence.quote: Mandibles: Sabre-like with variable curvatures; inner edges generally smooth (rarely finely serrated) with one distinct marginal tooth, sometimes very small, near molar tooth on each mandible
evidence.note: 支撑：Cubitermes 兵蚁上颚形态

evidence.quote: Antennae: Mostly of 14.5–15 articles, or rarely 14 (in 12% of specimens examined).
evidence.note: 支撑：Cubitermes 兵蚁触角节数

sources.title: An integrative revision of the genus Isognathotermes (Termitidae: Cubitermitinae) with description of seven new species and four new subspecies
sources.retrieved_via: PyMuPDF text extraction from publisher PDF

evidence.quote: The genus Isognathotermes is best and fully characterized by its worker’s EVA which takes two main forms and an intermediate form
evidence.note: 支撑：Isognathotermes 属级核心识别特征为工蚁肠瓣

evidence.quote: The worker is also characterized by the shape and spinosity of its front legs: the fore coxa is carinated and bears two to seven spines on the ventral carina (Fig. 7); the fore trochanter bears three to eight spines.
evidence.note: 支撑：Isognathotermes 工蚁前足基节与转节刺

evidence.quote: It has a long head (SHdL = 2.18–3.77 mm), a high head elongation index (SHdL/SHdW = 1.22–1.67), and the sabre-like mandibles are always shorter than the head (SMlL/SHdL = 0.66–0.92); antennae of 14–15 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：Isognathotermes 兵蚁头长、长宽比、上颚与触角

sources.title: A new termite species of the genus Dihoplotermes Araújo (Blattaria, Isoptera, Termitidae) from the Brazilian Amazonian rainforest

evidence.quote: The soldiers of Dihoplotermes taurus and Dihoplotermes inusitatus have two anterolateral spines near the base of the mandibles, above the mandibular condyle; asymmetric snapping mandibles ( Figure 1 ); asymmetrical labrum; and tibial spurs 3:2:2.
evidence.note: 支撑：Dihoplotermes 兵蚁属征

evidence.quote: Workers of both species have similar mandibles, with apical teeth distinctly larger than the first marginal teeth; right mandible without second marginal tooth; left mandible with third marginal tooth absent and molar tooth separated from first + second marginal by a small incision ( Figure 2 D).
evidence.note: 支撑：Dihoplotermes 工蚁上颚齿式

evidence.quote: The gut of both species has similarities regarding the gizzard, with a spine on the pulvillus ( Figure 7 B-C); presence of a malpighian nodule with two pairs of malpighian tubules inserted on the nodule ( Figure 1 A); enteric valve with a longitudinal row of spines on one cushion ( Figure 7 D-E).
evidence.note: 支撑：Dihoplotermes 肠部属征

evidence.locator: 章节 Krecekitermes gen. nov., Diagnosis（文章 pp. 317–352）
evidence.quote: Dehiscent organs fill the hemocoel anterior to the crop. The EVS forms three large lobes. The Mesenteron/P1 junction is well marked, but the mixed segment is short. The EVA armature of Krecekitermes is composed of cushions with six sclerotized and crown-shaped termini adorned with thorns.

evidence.locator: 章节 Mangolditermes gen. nov., Diagnosis
evidence.quote: In the left view, P1 makes a curve dorsally. The enteric valve seating (EVS) is weakly trilobed. The EVA is unarmed and composed of six elongated and inflated cushions, with well-marked fringed pentagonal scales in the distal half of the cushions. On the proximal ends, each cushion has about 10–20 tiny triangulate spines.
evidence.note: 鉴别要点与工蚁肠瓣、P1 走行

evidence.locator: 章节 Ourissotermes gen. nov., Diagnosis

sources.title: Rustitermes boteroi, a new genus and species of soldierless termites (Isoptera: Termitidae: Apicotermitinae) from South America
sources.retrieved_via: JATS XML 全文（去标签副本 zookeys922.txt）

evidence.locator: 章节 Rustitermes gen. nov., Diagnosis（文章 pp. 35–49）
evidence.quote: Enteric valve with six slightly asymmetrical cushions. Each cushion forming a central pouch made of scales smaller than those between the cushions. Each cushion composed of about 60–80 scales, wider at the base and narrower at the apex. Posterior portion of pads truncated, with 35 to 50 rectangular scales arranged from the middle to the apex of the cushion […]
evidence.note: 鉴别要点（6 个不对称瓣垫、中央囊袋、60–80 枚鳞片、后部 35–50 枚长方形鳞片）

evidence.quote: The digestive tube coiling of the new genus is similar to Hydrecotermes, but R. boteroi sp. nov. can be differentiated by the worker, which has thick bristles along the inner margin of the fore tibia, absent in Hydrecotermes.
evidence.note: 鉴别要点（与 Hydrecotermes 的区分：前胫节内缘粗刚毛）

evidence.quote: Worker (Figs 2–4). Monomorphic. Small and rounded fontanelle; postclypeus rather slightly inflated; head capsule covered with medium and long bristles.
evidence.note: 工蚁（单型、囟小而圆、后唇基稍膨隆、头壳毛被）

evidence.quote: In Aparatermes the insertion of P1 in P3 occurs in dorsal view with a trilobate EV setting
evidence.note: 支撑：P1 与 P3 的连接在背面观呈三叶状肠瓣座。

evidence.quote: the enteric valve of Aparatermes has small spines or pointy scales, which are absent in R. boteroi sp. nov.; in addition, the EV in Aparatermes has the posterior portion of the pads without scales
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣具小刺或尖鳞，且垫的后部无鳞片。

sources.title: Integrative taxonomic studies on Rinacapritermes Amina & Rajmohana, n. gen. (Blattodea: Isoptera: Termitidae: Termitinae) with two new species from India
sources.retrieved_via: PDF 全文（pdf_extract_text + 页面渲染核对）

evidence.quote: Morphological diagnosis. — Soldier. Soldiers with antennae 15 segmented, labrum with substraight anterior margin equipped with broad-based, robust and long antero-lateral points. Frons sharply inclining in front, fontanelle transverse and frontal gland large, postmentum club-shaped, pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin convex, without notch.

evidence.quote: The soldiers of Rinacapritermes Amina & Rajmohana, n. gen. have antennae with 15 segments vs 14 segments in Indocapritermes; anterior margin of labrum is substraight with broad based, robust and long, antero-lateral points in the new genus vs labrum with narrow based, short, thin and minute lateral points in the latter

evidence.quote: Worker. Head capsule. Monomorphic; head and body densely hairy. In dorsal view head subcircular, maximum width of head capsule at base of antennae. Fontanelle plate translucent and round. Antennae with 14-15 segments. Postclypeus swollen.

evidence.quote: Antennae with 13 segments; mandibles thin, slender and weakly bent at middle

evidence.quote: Left mandible moderately twisted at middle, sharply pointed at tip or forming a beak or bent like a hook

evidence.note: 属级鉴别：伸长的 mixed segment 与球形 diverticulum

evidence.quote: The genus mainly differs from Anoplotermes sensu stricto by the shape of its enteric valve, composed of six pads, each with ten to 20 long spines protruding into the paunch.
evidence.note: 与 Anoplotermes s.s. 的区别

evidence.quote: Imago: Eyes and ocelli of medium size. Fontanelle of medium size, appearing as an elongated white dot located between eyes.
evidence.note: 有翅成虫头部

evidence.quote: Patawatermes is very similar to Grigiotermes but can easily be distinguished from it by the shape of the armature of its worker enteric valve.
evidence.note: 属级鉴别：与 Grigiotermes 的区别

evidence.quote: Enteric valve inserted into a tubular extension of the paunch, with well-developed armature composed of six rounded spiny pads.
evidence.note: 肠瓣插入位置与 armature

evidence.quote: Imago: Sclerotized body parts dark brown, covered by thousands of tiny setae.
evidence.note: 有翅成虫体色与刚毛

evidence.quote: Rubeotermes workers are distinctive from all other South American soldierless termites in that they turn red in alcohol and have some long and thick spines on the forecoxa.
evidence.note: 属级鉴别（唯一性）

evidence.quote: Mesenteron and proctodeum connection truncated, devoid of mixed segment.
evidence.note: 无 mixed segment

evidence.quote: Worker: Large, with head width of about 1 mm.
evidence.note: 属级体型

evidence.quote: Description Worker: Medium-sized (see Table 3). Head pale yellow, rounded to slightly ovoid, fully covered by about 60 setae. Fontanelle indistinct. Mandibles as in Figure 2D. Fore tibia strongly inﬂated, about three times as long as wide.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁中型、头淡黄被约 60 根刚毛、前胫节强烈膨大约 3 倍于宽。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve inserted into an extension of the paunch, consisting of six elongated pads, each composed of about 100 scales and endowed posteriorly with about 15 weakly sclerotized spines.
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣着生于 paunch 延伸部，6 个细长垫、每垫约 100 枚鳞片、后缘约 15 根弱硬化刺。

evidence.quote: Amplucrutermes is clearly distinct from all other described South American soldierless termite genera. It can be recognized by its enlarged fore tibia, which are similar to Tetimatermes but less concave and lacking proximal glands. The enteric valves of Amplucrutermes, composed of about 100 scales and 15 weakly sclerotized apical spines, are also diagnostic (Fig. 2C).
evidence.note: 支撑：与所有已知南美无兵蚁白蚁属区分；前胫节似 Tetimatermes 但凹陷较浅、近端无腺体；肠瓣约 100 鳞片 + 15 根弱硬化端刺。

evidence.quote: Hydrecotermes is morphologically closest to Grigiotermes and Patawatermes but can easily be distinguished from these two genera by its smaller workers devoid of enteric valve armatures. Its workers differ from other Neotropical soldierless termites by their enlarged P1 and overall squat abdomen, and by their oval enteric valve cushions without armature.
evidence.note: 支撑：最接近 Grigiotermes 与 Patawatermes，工蚁更小且肠瓣无硬化 armature；P1 膨大、腹部粗短、肠瓣垫卵形无刺。

evidence.quote: Medium-sized, with head width between 0.6 and 0.8 mm. Abdomen with slightly enlarged digestive tract. Head pale yellow, rounded, covered by 50 to 200 bristles and devoid of tiny ones.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁中型、头宽 0.6–0.8 mm、腹部消化道略膨大、头淡黄圆形被 50–200 根刚毛而无微毛。

evidence.quote: Sclerotized body dark brown, covered by thousands of tiny setae. Head covered by a few long bristles. Eyes and ocelli large. Fontanelle fairly large, situated at the posterior level of eyes and appearing as a spot devoid of setae.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫体部深褐密被微毛、头仅数根长刚毛、复眼与单眼大、fontanelle 大而位于复眼后缘水平且无毛。

evidence.quote: Worker: Large, head width over 0.9 mm. Abdomen with subconical distal half and elongated digestive tract.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁体型大（头宽 > 0.9 mm）、腹末半亚圆锥形、消化道延长。

evidence.quote: Head pale yellow, rounded, fully covered with various numbers of tiny setae and between 50 and 100 long bristles. Fontanelle small, almost indistinct. Fore tibia long and slender.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁头淡黄、圆形，密被小毛与 50–100 根长刚毛；囟小几不可见；前胫节细长。

evidence.quote: Imago: Sclerotized body parts dark brown, covered by thousands of tiny setae. Head covered by about 100 scattered long bristles. Eyes and ocelli large.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫硬化部深褐、密被小毛；头具约 100 根散生长刚毛；复眼与单眼大。

evidence.quote: Grigiotermes is distinguishable from other genera of South American soldierless termites by its workers with widened P 1 in which the food bolus has a visible serpentine path.
evidence.note: 支撑：以工蚁 P1 极宽、食物团呈可见蛇形路径区别于南美其他无兵蚁属。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve inserted into a short extension of the paunch, with welldeveloped armature composed of six spiny plates.
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣位于胃（paunch）的短延伸部内，武装为 6 块具刺骨板。

evidence.quote: Mesenteric junction forming a small ball overlapping the proctodeum, slightly elongated to form a short, distinct mixed segment.
evidence.note: 支撑：中肠接点成小球状叠于后肠之上，略延长形成短而明显的混合段。

evidence.quote: Fontanelle fairly small to medium size, situated at the level of eyes. Pronotum elongated, covered by dozens of long bristles.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫囟小至中等、位于复眼水平；前胸背板延长。

sources.notes: 一条来源支撑 Humutermes（pp. 20–22）、Patawatermes、Rubeotermes（pp. 27–30）三属，按 canonical DOI 合并为一条记录。Patawatermes 的属级 treatment 页码未能核实（Zenodo 记录只给 isPartOf 全文，未给页码）；batch 中该属原始 URL 的 hash 实指向 Humutermes 的 treatment。特别提示：_tmp/lit/batches/05-gaps.json 把本 DOI 的题名写成 'Towards a better understanding of the nervous system in termites…'，与 DOI 实际题名不符，疑为题录串行，引用时应以本记录题名为准。
sources.publisher: The Linnean Society of London / Oxford University Press

sources.title: Tucupitermes, the largest Apicotermitinae (Isoptera, Termitidae) from the Amazon Rainforest

evidence.quote: Left mandible with a cutting-edge length twice as long as the distance between the apical tooth and M1+2
evidence.note: 属级鉴别第一条

evidence.quote: Stomodeal valve long, twice as long as the length of the crop.
evidence.note: stomodeal valve 比例

evidence.quote: Mesenteric tongue is long and slightly globular, reaching midline of abdomen
evidence.note: mesenteric tongue

sources.title: Sandsitermes gen. nov., a new nasute termite genus from South America (Isoptera, Termitidae, Nasutitermitinae)

evidence.quote: Imagoes with dorsal surface of head capsule with slight elevation anterior to fontanelle, where the ocelli are situated
evidence.note: 有翅成虫头部隆起

evidence.quote: Soldiers with long conical nasus, but no apparent uniquely distinct morphological character.
evidence.note: 兵蚁无独有特征

evidence.quote: Workers showing distinct set of morphological characters involving mandibles with concave molar area with no well-developed ridges
evidence.note: 工蚁上颚与肠

evidence.quote: The imagoes of Sandsitermes, Caetetermes, Caribitermes, Cortaritermes, Nasutitermes and Obtusitermes have the postclypeus slightly arched in profile, with its anterior margin straight and the posterior margin slightly convex
evidence.note: 支撑：Obtusitermes 有翅成虫后唇基侧面观微拱、前缘平直、后缘微凸（排印空格已整理）

sources.notes: 正文经 Plazi treatment（pp. 563–569）读取。属级 Description 含 Imago / Soldier / Worker 三节，工蚁二型在属级节内区分。

sources.title: A new genus and species of termites (Isoptera, Termitidae, Nasutitermitinae) from the rainforest of northern Peru

evidence.quote: distal margin of the enteric valve (P2) not everted into the paunch (P3) but bending towards the ileum (P1), that is, directed against the flow of food
evidence.note: 属级鉴别核心：肠瓣远端逆流弯折

evidence.quote: armed with one ring of six equal subtriangularly-shaped ridges, each ridge with short spines on entire surface
evidence.note: armature 一环六脊

evidence.quote: sinqa = nose and sapa = big, and Latin termes = termite, meaning termite with a big nose
evidence.note: 属名词源（兵蚁 nasus 大）

evidence.quote: Agnathotermes Snyder and Paraconvexitermes Cancello & Noirot also have a conical nasus and antenna with 11 articles, but they differ from Sinqasapatermes by their chaetotaxy and head shape of the soldier.
evidence.note: 支撑：Paraconvexitermes 兵蚁象鼻锥形、触角 11 节

evidence.quote: Reduced ridges on molar areas are found in Araujotermes , Atlantitermes , Coatitermes , Convexitermes , Ereymatermes , Paraconvexitermes , and Subulitermes , but none of these genera have lost the marginal teeth.
evidence.note: 支撑：Ereymatermes 与 Paraconvexitermes 工蚁臼齿区脊减弱但保留缘齿

sources.notes: 属级 Diagnosis 仅列肠部特征；兵蚁与工蚁体壁特征在属级 Description 内。imago 记为 Unknown。页内 locator 用章节名，未逐页核对页码。

sources.title: Schievitermes globicornis, a new genus and species of Termitinae (Blattodea, Termitidae) from French Guiana

evidence.quote: Among neotropical snappers, the absence of a frontal projection distinguishes Schievitermes from Termes , Inquilinitermes , Cavitermes , Palmitermes , Dihoplotermes , and Cornicapritermes.
evidence.note: 属级鉴别：无额突

evidence.quote: Antennae of 13 articles, apical article reaching beyond left mandible tip; article 3 distinctly globular, as broad as article 1 and broader than all other articles.
evidence.note: 兵蚁触角 13 节、第 3 节球状

evidence.quote: The digestive tube of Schievitermes is similar to that of Planicapritermes , but the bilobed apex of the mesenteric part of the mixed segment is distinctive.
evidence.note: 工蚁消化道双叶特征

sources.notes: 页码冲突：Pensoft 页面 Citation 写 ZooKeys 1125: 103–124，XML 的 fpage/lpage 为 103–114，batch 与本记录取后者；正式引用前建议以期刊 PDF 页脚复核。属级 Imago 仅有蚁后。

sources.title: New genera on the Subulitermes branch of the Nasutitermitinae from the Ethiopian region (Isoptera, Termitidae)

evidence.quote: Imaco (Fic. 6): Head and postclypeus covered rather thinly with very short hairs and also with several long bristles. Pronotum with nu- merous long bristles near the margins of the sides and rear; surface with a few short hairs. Tergites and sternites with many long bristles or hairs about equal in length on both the tergites and sternites.
evidence.note: 支撑：Postsubulitermes 有翅成虫头与后唇基被稀疏短毛并有长刚毛、前胸背板多长刚毛

evidence.quote: Mandibles as in figure 10. Each mandible with a very long apical tooth and a reduced cutting edge behind the first marginal tooth. The left mandible index is 2.91, indicating a proportionately longer apical
evidence.note: 支撑：Tarditermes 有翅成虫上颚端齿极长、左颚指数 2.91

evidence.quote: Length of head 1.39-1.53 Width of head 0.55-0.60 Thickness of head with postmentum 0.50-0.56 Width of pronotum 0.34-0.39 Length of hind tibia 0.71-0.79
evidence.note: 支撑：Postsubulitermes 兵蚁头长 1.39–1.53 mm、头宽 0.55–0.60 mm、后足胫节 0.71–0.79 mm

evidence.quote: The soldier of Verrucositermes is unique among all known genera of nasute termites in its possession of numerous conspicuous tubercles on the head and antennae. Because of their structure and position, these tubercles are probably olfactory sense organs.
evidence.locator: p.5，Verrucositermes 原始描述之后的评论
evidence.note: 支撑：疣白蚁属兵蚁疣突的独特性与功能推测（Emerson 原始描述）

sources.notes: 1960 年 3 月 1 日出版（No. 1987），建立 Verrucositermes、Afrosubulitermes、Postsubulitermes、Tarditermes 四新属；属级描述明确分 IMAGO / SOLDIER / Worker（OCR 把 IMAGO 印成 Imaco、FIG. 印成 Fic.），并附 Table 4–7 测量。Postsubulitermes、Tarditermes 两属的体色与测量值取自其后的种记述（P. parviconstrictus、T. contracolor），在 04-7.json 中已标明。

sources.title: Rounditermes dechambrei, a new genus and species of Nasutitermitinae from French Guiana (Isopt., Termitidae)
sources.retrieved_via: Persée 文章页全文 HTML（无 PDF 下载）→ _tmp/out11.txt

evidence.quote: Rounditermes n. gen. mainly differs from the closely related genus Cortari¬ termes in the presence of 14 antennal segments in soldier, its longer and broader soldier head, its relatively longer hind tibia of soldier, the absence of microscopic pilosity of the soldier head, its nasus more conical and shorter than in the Cortaritermes spp.
evidence.note: 支撑：Rounditermes 与 Cortaritermes 的四项兵蚁区别（触角 14 节、头更长更宽、后足胫节相对更长、头面无微毛、鼻更锥形且较短）

evidence.quote: mean dimensions (based on ten specimens) : length of entire soldier, 5.20mm ; length of head with nasus, 1.99mm ; width of head, 1.55 mm ; length of nasus, 0.72 mm ; length of pronotum, 0.4 mm ; length of antennae, 1.97 mm
evidence.note: 支撑：Rounditermes 兵蚁 10 头标本的均值测量

sources.title: A revision of the neotropical termite genus Neocapritermes (Isoptera, Termitidae, Termitinae)

evidence.quote: Imago: Head usually without dense pubescence, in some cases covered with short hair and a few bristles of two sizes; pronotum more densely covered with hair and bristles. Fontanelle plate sclerotized, without visible opening. Ocellus large, not touching eye. Antennae with 16 or 17 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：新扭白蚁属有翅成虫头毛被、囟板、单眼、触角节数

evidence.quote: Soldier: Neotropical Termitinae with conspicuously distorted, asymmetrical, snapping mandibles and without “nose” or conical horizontal projection of frons; monomorphic (in spite of variation in size), without frontal gland; fontanelle circular; head not flattened, evenly rounded at posterior margin.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁不对称弹射上颚、无额腺、囟圆形、头后缘圆

sources.notes: 正文据 archive.org 的 djvu.txt OCR 文本读取；OCR 有个别字符噪声，引用句段为干净段落。原书只列 Imago 与 Soldier 属级诊断，工蚁仅给图 1 上颚图。

sources.title: Chasitermes pax, a new genus and species of soldierless termite (Termitidae, Apicotermitinae) from the island of Trinidad

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. The combination of unsclerotized rectangular EVA cushions, a tubular extension of EVS, and a prominent spherical mesenteric tongue make C. pax unique among all Apicotermitinae genera.
evidence.note: 支撑：不硬化长方形 EVA 垫、EVS 管状延伸、球形 mesenteric tongue 三特征组合使其区别于全部 Apicotermitinae 属。

evidence.quote: Description. Imago unknown. Worker. (Figs 1–4). Monomorphic. Head capsule and antennae light yellowish.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫未知、单型、头壳与触角淡黄。

evidence.quote: Cuticle of EVA without sclerotization (Fig. 4A, B) forming six rectangular cushions with about 100 scales each (Fig. 4A).
evidence.note: 支撑：EVA 角质层不硬化，形成 6 个长方形垫，每垫约 100 枚鳞片。

sources.notes: JATS 全文（_tmp/lit/fulltext/07-noentry-a/chasitermes.xml）与出版社 PDF（_tmp/lit/pdfs/07-noentry-a/chasitermes.pdf）互校；引文取自 JATS（已去行内标签），页数据 PDF 印刷页码。

sources.title: Echinotermes biriba, a new genus and species of soldierless termite from the Colombian and Peruvian Amazon (Termitidae, Apicotermitinae)

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. The crop of E. biriba is unusually large and the enteric valve armature, consisting of six spherical pectinate pads, is unique among all apicotermitine genera.
evidence.note: 支撑：嗉囊异常大、肠瓣为 6 个球形栉状垫，在 Apicotermitinae 中独有。

evidence.quote: Monomorphic. Head capsule and antennae a light yellowish colour; pronotum pale yellow; legs hyaline.
evidence.note: 支撑：单型、头与触角淡黄、前胸背板淡黄、足透明。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve seating trilobed, with smaller lobe not visible in intact gut. Enteric valve with six cushions, terminating at the opening to the P3 as spiny spheroids (Fig. 2).
evidence.note: 支撑：EVS 三叶且较小一叶在完整肠道中不可见；肠瓣 6 垫，末端呈带刺球状。

sources.notes: JATS 全文（_tmp/lit/fulltext/07-noentry-a/echinotermes.xml）与出版社 PDF 互校；属级 Diagnosis 位于 p. 24。

sources.title: Compositermes vindai (Isoptera: Termitidae: Apicotermitinae), a new genus and species of soldierless termite from the Neotropics

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. The enteric valve cushions, much enlarged and tubular enteric valve seating, and the sclerotized pectinate paddles at the S/P3 junction are unique among all termite workers.
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣垫增大、EVS 长管状、S/P3 交界处硬化栉状小铲，为全体白蚁工蚁中所仅见。

evidence.quote: P2 formed by six slightly incongruent, egg-shaped cushions. Intersection of S and P3 embellished with 15–20 small pectinate paddles visible externally in situ under microscope when abdominal integument removed.
evidence.note: 支撑：P2 由 6 个略不整齐的卵形垫组成；S/P3 交界处 15–20 枚小栉状铲，剥去体壁后自外部可见。

evidence.quote: Imago unknown. Worker (Figs. 3–6). Monomorphic. Fore tibia moderately inflated (ratio length/width 3.98).
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫未知；单型；前胫节中度膨大，长宽比 3.98。

evidence.quote: Compositermes vindai is named in honor of Boudanath (Vinda) Maharajh (1950-2009) who first joined our termite diversity survey team in 1996 at his homeland of Trinidad and Tobago
evidence.note: 支撑：vindai 纪念特立尼达采集助手 Boudanath Vinda Maharajh

sources.notes: PDF 自 mapress.com 公开下载（bz2 无）；Zootaxa 未在 PDF 内标注开放许可，故 license 记 unknown。属级描述跨 pp. 381–383。

sources.title: Gastrotermes spinatus gen. n. sp. n., an African soil-feeding termite described from the worker caste (Isoptera, Termitidae, Apicotermitidae)

evidence.quote: Description. Imago. Unknown. Soldier. Unknown, but may exist. Worker. Head, pronotum, and abdomen covered with hundreds of long or very long hairs
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫未知、兵蚁未知但可能存在；工蚁头、前胸背板与腹部密被数百根长至很长的毛。

evidence.quote: An absence of a mixed segment and the presence of both a very short P1 and a voluminous trilobite enteric valve seating places Gastrotermes in the Apicotermes group (sensu Noirot 2001).
evidence.note: 支撑：无 mixed segment、P1 很短、EVS 大而三叶，归入 Apicotermes 群。

evidence.quote: Also, genera within the Labidotermes subgroup lack P3a spines (as in L. celisi Deligne and Pasteels, Fig. 4C) while in Gastrotermes, the EVS is lined with small erect spines and the opening of the P3a is lined with many robust spines.
evidence.locator: p. 291, Diagnosis（与 Labidotermes 亚群对比）
evidence.note: 支撑：该亚群其他属 P3a 无刺，而本属 EVS 内壁具小直立刺、P3a 开口列粗壮刺。

sources.notes: PDF 自 mapress.com 公开下载；许可未标注。属级描述与 Diagnosis 同在 p. 291。

sources.title: Ebogotermes raphaeli, new genus and new species, an African soldierless termite described from the worker caste (Isoptera, Termitidae, Apicotermitinae)

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. Ebogotermes is the largest (Figs. 1, 2) of the soldierless apicotermitine workers in equatorial Africa.
evidence.note: 支撑：为赤道非洲无兵蚁 apicotermitine 工蚁中体型最大者。

evidence.quote: The circular mesenteron, well-developed mixed segment, moderately long P1, P3/P4 isthmus, and long tubular P4 place Ebogotermes in the Anoplotermes-group (Noirot, 2001).
evidence.note: 支撑：中肠成环、mixed segment 发达、P1 中等长、P3/P4 缢部、P4 长管状，归入 Anoplotermes 群。

evidence.quote: Worker. Head, thorax, abdomen, and legs covered with setae of varying lengths. Antennae with 14 articles. Postclypeus moderately inflated. Fore tibia slightly inflated. Tibial spurs 3, 2, 2.
evidence.note: 支撑：全身被长短不一刚毛、触角 14 节、后唇基中度膨大、前胫节轻微膨大、胫节距 3:2:2。

evidence.quote: Named for Raphael Awoumou Onana, the chief of Ebogo village, a resilient guide, and expert on Cameroonian termites.
evidence.note: 支撑：raphaeli 纪念 Raphael Awoumou Onana

sources.notes: PDF 自 mapress.com 公开下载；许可未标注。属级描述在 p. 279。

sources.title: Phylogeny and generic reclassification of the Capritermes complex (Isoptera, Termitidae, Termitinae)

evidence.quote: Head very flat, with sides converging toward front; posterior margin three-lobed, middle lobe not so prominent; fontanelle small and circular; and frontal gland absent.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头极扁、两侧前收、后缘三叶、囟小圆、额腺缺。

evidence.quote: Left mandible strongly bent in middle, with base thick, its outer region with ridge and concavity; anterior region spatulate; apex blunt; and inner basal region with toothlike projection, fitting into corresponding excavation in right mandible. Right mandible flat and straight. Antennae with 14 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁左上颚形态、右上颚平直、触角 14 节。

evidence.quote: Left mandible with apical tooth small, posterior margin of fused first plus second marginal tooth long, third marginal tooth well developed. Right mandible with posterior margin of second marginal tooth straight and acute angle between first and second marginal teeth.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁左右上颚齿式。

evidence.quote: Imago (fig. 2): Small, dark brown. Head densely hairy, with numerous stiff bristles interspersed with short hairs. Fontanelle distinct, narrow, elliptical. Eyes small.
evidence.note: 支撑：Paracapritermes 有翅成虫形态

evidence.quote: Labrum with anterior margin almost straight or faintly angular, in some individuals faintly indented in middle, and anterolateral corners slightly pointed.
evidence.note: 支撑：Paracapritermes 兵蚁上唇形态（与 Protocapritermes 共衍征）

evidence.quote: Tibial spurs 3:2:2. Middle tibia with one spine in primus
evidence.note: 支撑：Paracapritermes 胫节端距式与中胫刺数（原文下接 two in kraepelinii，因跨行连字符截断未引入；转述见描述）

sources.title: Updated taxonomy of Syntermitinae (Blattodea: Isoptera, Termitidae), with the description of three new genera
sources.license: unknown（Plazi 收录的 treatment XML；文章授权条款未核实）
sources.retrieved_via: Plazi treatment XML（tb.plazi.org/GgServer/xml/03BB783DFFBA5720FF3896DA78F80064 等）→ 去标签纯文本

evidence.quote: All three genera workers have pulvilli ornamented with conspicuous spines ( Fig. 2a ), a character absent in all other members of Syntermitinae
evidence.locator: p. 447–449，属级 Description「Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae」段
evidence.note: 支撑：Syntermitinae 中仅 Biratermes、Mapinguaritermes、Ibitermes 三属工蚁垫具显著刺——本属鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: In the new genera the soldier mandibles are bladelike and robust, and the forecoxae have a smooth surface
evidence.locator: p. 447–449，属级 Description「Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae」段
evidence.note: 支撑：原文对三个新属的共同兵蚁特征：上颚刀状粗壮、前基节表面光滑，而 Embiratermes s.s. 为具尖端穿刺型上颚、前基节腹缘有突起——兵蚁节（本属兵蚁外部形态本身沿用 Constantino 1992）。

evidence.quote: Cuticular armature of gizzard with 24 visible folds, six of these first-order, six second-order and 12 third-order; ratio between columnar and pulvillar belts approximately equal to one; pulvillus I (major) ornamented with conspicuous spines
evidence.note: 支撑：砂囊 24 褶（6/6/12）、柱状带与垫状带近等、第一级垫具显著刺——工蚁节。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve (P2) composed of three nearly equal conical ridges, covered with curved spines ( Fig. 14b ), [ Constantino (1990) fig. 12)]. Dorsal torsion well developed. Third proctodeal segment joined P4 by an isthmus is inserted subapically
evidence.note: 支撑：P2 三锥形脊覆弯刺、峡部近端插入——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Head elongate, rectangular or sub-rectangular, narrowing slightly towards front with lateral and posterior margins slightly convex and posterolateral angles broadly rounded
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头长方形、后侧角宽圆——兵蚁节。

evidence.quote: Worker . Head capsule rounded. Postclypeus moderately inflated or more inflated. Antenna with 14 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁头圆、后唇基中等至较强膨大、触角 14 节——工蚁节。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve (P2) composed of three nearly equal ridges covered with thin curved spines ( Figs 6b , 11b ). Dorsal torsion well-developed. P3 joined to P4 by an isthmus is inserted subapically
evidence.note: 支撑：P2 三脊覆细弯刺、峡部近端插入——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Head sub-rectangular, with lateral and posterior margins of varying convexity, rounded posterolateral angles; moderate-sized conical nasus
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头近长方形、鼻圆锥形中等——兵蚁节。

evidence.quote: Worker . Head capsule rounded. Postclypeus short and inflated. Antennae with 13 or 14 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁头圆、后唇基短而膨大、触角 13 或 14 节——工蚁节。

evidence.quote: Soldiers of Cahuallitermes Constantino have a rounded head, a well-developed labrum tip, and a postmentum with convex lateral margins
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Biratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头圆、上唇端部发达、后颏侧缘凸。

evidence.quote: In the genera Cyrilliotermes Fontes and Curvitermes Holmgren the soldiers have peculiar mandibles, with a molar plate, molar prominence, and marginal teeth quite similar to the mandibles of their corresponding workers.
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Biratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚“异常”，具磨板、磨突与缘齿，形似同名工蚁的上颚。

evidence.quote: In addition, the apical tooth is hook-shaped in Curvitermes
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Biratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚端齿呈鱼钩状。

evidence.quote: and cylindrical and elongated frontal tube in the Cyrilliotermes soldier
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Biratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁额管圆柱状且延长。

evidence.quote: Embiratermes s.s. species have piercing mandibles with a sharp point, and a projection in the ventral margin of the forecoxae.
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Biratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚穿刺型、末端锐尖；前足基节腹缘具突起。

evidence.quote: the mesenteric tongue is straight and does not reach the dilated portion of the P1
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Biratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁中肠舌直、不达 P1 膨大部。

evidence.quote: short and broad, at the middle of the abdomen length in Embiratermes s.s.
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Bandeiratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣段短而宽，位于腹部中点。

evidence.quote: The soldiers of Embiratermes s.s. have piercing mandibles with marginal teeth at the proximal third of the mandible length
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Bandeiratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁缘齿位于上颚长度近端 1/3 处。

evidence.quote: The soldiers of Ibitermes s.s. have a markedly inflated postclypeus (absent in the new genus).
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Bandeiratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁后唇基显著膨大。

evidence.quote: Ibitermes s.s. has a markedly inflated postclypeus and the mandibles lack marginal teeth
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Biratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁后唇基显著膨大、上颚无缘齿。

evidence.quote: The worker gut of Ibitermes s.s. have a long and twisted mesenteric tongue (short and rounded in Bandeiratermes gen. n.), and the enteric valve segment is dorsally oriented
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Bandeiratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁中肠舌长而扭曲，肠瓣段背向。

evidence.quote: Noirotitermes Cancello & Myles are smaller with piercing mandibles
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Biratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁体型较小、上颚穿刺型。

evidence.quote: that of Noirotitermes with a remarkably distinctive shape to the head capsule. In both of the latter genera, there is a characteristic microsculpture present on the surface of the head capsule.
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Biratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头囊形状极为独特，且头表具特征性微 sculpturing。

evidence.quote: Soldiers of Paracurvitermes Constantino & Carvalho are smaller, and have a well-developed conical and shorter frontal tube than Biratermes ; and the mandibles are distinctly curved.
evidence.locator: Comparisons with other genera of Syntermitinae（Biratermes 属征比较）
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁体型较小，额管发达、圆锥形且较短，上颚明显弯曲。

sources.notes: 为 3 个属（拜拉白蚁属、班代拉白蚁属、瓦宁白蚁属）提供属级形态文本；本记录逐字摘录合计 1434 字符。

sources.title: Muelleritermes: A new termite genus with two species from the Brazilian Atlantic Forest (Isoptera: Termitidae: Nasutitermitinae)

evidence.quote: can be easily distinguished from other members of Nasutitermitinae , except Velocitermes and Diversitermes , by the presence of three types of soldiers and a pair of vestigial ocelli (described below) on the soldier's head
evidence.note: 支撑：三型兵蚁 + 一对退化单眼，仅本属与 Velocitermes、Diversitermes 具——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Trimorphic. Head capsule of major soldier broad, rounded, almost square or slightly oval, without constriction behind antennae ( M. globiceps , sp. n. ), occasionally very slightly constricted (some individuals in M. fritzi , sp. n. ), oval or slightly oval in intermediate soldier.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁三型；大型兵头近方形或略卵形、触角后无收缩，中型兵头卵形——兵蚁节。

evidence.quote: Worker : Dimorphic, the minor worker occurs rarely. Major worker has two types of mandibles (termed narrow- and broad-gap by Fontes, 1987 ). Head rounded ( Fig. 3 ), antennae with 14 articles, postclypeus not inflated, fontanelle inconspicuous
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁二型、上颚两式、头圆、触角 14 节、后唇基不膨大——工蚁节。

sources.notes: 为 1 个属（米勒白蚁属）提供属级形态文本；本记录逐字摘录合计 747 字符。

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. Worker and imago. Fontanelle very large in dorsal view, ranging from 1/4 to 3/4 the diameter of the head capsule ( Figs. 1B ; 2A, C, E ); two rows of spine-like bristles on the inner face of the protibia
evidence.note: 支撑：囟极大（1/4–3/4）+ 前足胫节两列刺状刚毛——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Mono- or dimorphic ( Figs. 2 ; 3 B–D, H, 4, 5). Head capsule flattened dorsoventrally in profile, rounded in dorsal view. Fontanelle margins well delineated, depressed within vertex, occupying 1/4 to 3/4 of the head capsule ( Fig. 2A,C, E , see histological discussion below). Antenna with 14 articles. Postclypeus moderately to highly inflated.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁头形、囟缘与大小、触角 14、后唇基膨大——工蚁节。

evidence.quote: Head capsule trapezoidal in dorsal view, flattened dorsoventrally in profile ( Fig. 1A, B ). Two frontal marks located in dorsal view between the postclypeus and ocellus, above the antenna insertion ( Fig. 1B , arrows), larger than the ocelli, and two smaller triangular marks between the frontal marks and the fontanelle
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫头背视梯形；额斑位于后唇基与单眼之间、触角着生处上方，大于单眼；额斑与囟之间另有较小的三角斑——有翅成虫节。

evidence.quote: In reference to the character Friar Tuck, the supposed Franciscan monk of the legend of Robin Hood.
evidence.note: 支撑：tucki 纪念罗宾汉传说人物 Friar Tuck

authors: Figueiredo, R. E. C. R. de

evidence.quote: Enteric valve seating (EVS) forms a well-defined ring at the enteric valve (EV) insertion, followed by a short tubular portion of P3. It also features a mesenteric tongue with a whitish spherical mesenteric nodule in ventral view. EV with three semi-spherical sclerotized plates.
evidence.locator: pp. 383–396，「Diagnosis」段（Plazi treatment；PDF 分页未逐页核对）
evidence.note: 支撑：EVS 环、中肠结节、三块硬化板——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Monomorphic, with a pale-yellow head covered by sparsely spaced bristles of the same color. Head slightly convex in profile, post-clypeal region inflated, and fontanelle not visible. Antenna composed of 14 segments, with relative lengths 2>3=4<5.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁单型、体色、后唇基区、触角 14 节及相对长度——工蚁节。

evidence.quote: The gizzard is inconspicuous and unarmed and follows the pattern found in most soil-termites, being underdeveloped, with four first-order pulvilli, and the pulvilli surface with pectinated scales.
evidence.note: 支撑：砂囊不显无刺、4 个一级垫具栉状鳞——工蚁节消化道部分。

sources.title: Neotropical termites: revision of Armitermes Wasmann (Isoptera, Termitidae, Syntermitinae) and phylogeny of the Syntermitinae
sources.license: unknown（Wiley 出版社版权；所读为订阅刊 PDF，非 OA 授权）
sources.retrieved_via: 出版社 PDF（_tmp/lit/pdf/armitermes2012.pdf）→ PyMuPDF 抽文本，保留原排版断行连字符

evidence.quote: The soldier of Silvestritermes gen.n. can be distinguished from Armitermes because the former lacks a row of short thick spines on the margins of the pro-, meso- and metanotum
evidence.note: 支撑：前、中、后胸背板边缘无一行短粗刺，可与 Armitermes 区分——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Soldier. Monomorphic. Head capsule, in dorsal view, rounded or with lateral margins rounded with angular lateral posterior corners. Frontal tube conical, in dorsal view extend- ing beyond the labrum
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁单型、头形、额管背视伸出上唇——兵蚁节。

evidence.quote: Worker. Monomorphic. Head capsule rounded, with incon- spicuous epicranial suture; fontanelle oval, but very inconspic- uous (except in Silvestritermes lanei). Postclypeus and labrum as in imago. Antennae with 13 or 14 articles
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁单型、头圆、囟极不显（lanei 除外）、触角 13/14 节——工蚁节。

evidence.quote: The soldier of Uncitermes gen.n. is easily distinguished from Armitermes by the hooked mandibles, the absence of a conspicuous row of short thick spines on the margins of the pro-, meso- and metanotum, and the lack of keel-shaped projections and thick bristles on the forecoxae.
evidence.note: 支撑：钩状上颚、无背板短粗刺列、前基节无龙骨突起与粗刚毛——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Soldier. Monomorphic. Head capsule, in dorsal view, rounded. Frontal tube conical, same length as base of head capsule; forming a nearly 45◦angle with base of head, in pro- ﬁle. Antennae with 15 articles. Labrum rounded, anterior mar- gin hyaline, without distinct tip. Postmentum sub-rectangular
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头圆、额管与头基等长、触角 15、上唇圆、后颏近长方形——兵蚁节。

evidence.quote: Worker. Monomorphic. Head capsule rounded; epicranial suture inconspicuous; fontanelle oval, little visible. Antennae with 15 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁单型、头圆、囟不明显、触角 15 节——工蚁节。

evidence.quote: Also, the gizzard pulvilli in Mapinguaritermes gen.n. is ornamented with well-developed spines, which is also a synapomorphy of the new genus in our analysis.
evidence.note: 支撑：砂囊一级垫具发达刺，为本属共衍征——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Head capsule oval, in dorsal view. Frontal tube conical, almost parallel to base of head capsule, and approximately four-ﬁfths of its length in proﬁle. Antennae with 14 articles. Labrum almost pentagonal, anterior margin hyaline, without distinct tip. Postmentum with concave sides. Piercing mandibles symmetrical; only one marginal tooth, acute and inward-orientated
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头卵形、额管约为头基长的 4/5、触角 14 节、上唇近五边形、后颏两侧凹、上颚仅一枚内向锐齿——兵蚁节。

evidence.quote: Worker. Monomorphic. Head capsule rounded; epicranial suture not evident; fontanelle oval, but very discreet. Post- clypeus little inﬂated. Antennae with 14 articles.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁单型、头圆、囟很不明显、后唇基稍膨大、触角 14 节——工蚁节。

evidence.quote: Laminar mandibles, with an incision anterior to the first marginal teeth; postmentum finely rugose; Mexico, Belize and Honduras
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 11
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚片状、第一缘齿前具切刻；后颏细皱；分布于墨西哥至洪都拉斯。

evidence.quote: Mandibles with the molar region enlarged and a posteriorly pointed subapical tooth
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 7
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚磨区扩大、具向后指的亚端齿，据此与无此特征的类群（9 支）分开。

evidence.quote: Frontal tube with a smooth surface; broad and conical.
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 8
evidence.note: 支撑：额管表面光滑、宽锥形（与 Cyrilliotermes 的皱褶环状端相对）。

evidence.quote: Frontal tube wrinkled with irregular transverse ridges and with a doughnut-shaped tip
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 8
evidence.note: 支撑：额管具不规则横脊而皱褶、端部环状（doughnut-shaped）。

evidence.quote: Mandibles with a recognisable marginal tooth, near the middle or near the base; clypeus not inflated.
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 12
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚具可辨缘齿（近中部或基部），唇基不膨大。

evidence.quote: Head capsule elongate and sub-rectangular in dorsal view; length of base of head capsule normally more than the width
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 10
evidence.note: 支撑：头囊背面观延长、近长方形，头基部长大于宽。

evidence.quote: Mandibles without marginal teeth; clypeus strongly inflated (except in I. tellustris Constantino)
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 12
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚无缘齿、唇基强烈膨大（I. tellustris 除外）。

evidence.quote: marginal tooth on the middle of mandibles, dimorphic soldiers
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 6
evidence.note: 支撑：上颚缘齿位于中部，兵蚁二型。

evidence.quote: Posterior region of head with four conspicuous protuberances resembling horns; sides convex, with a slight constriction at the anterior half
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 14
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头后部具四个角状显著突起，两侧凸、前半略收缢。

evidence.quote: Piercing mandibles, with a conspicuous marginal tooth near the base; South America
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 11
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁上颚穿刺型、基部附近具显著缘齿。

evidence.quote: Head capsule rounded or sub-quadrate; length of the base of head capsule almost equal to width
evidence.locator: Key to genera of Syntermitinae, couplet 10
evidence.note: 支撑：头囊圆或近方形，头基部长约等于宽。

sources.title: Phylogeny and revision of the “Cubitermes complex” termites (Termitidae: Cubitermitinae)
sources.license: unknown（Wiley 出版社版权；所读为作者接受稿，非正式排版本）
sources.retrieved_via: 作者接受稿 PDF（ULB DI-fusion 2013/312908）→ PyMuPDF 抽文本，去除行号与页眉

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. Two worker enteric valve patterns are found within this group: either with three PCs (PC3, PC4, and PC5) ending downstream in yellow to brown sclerotized spatulae or with all six PCs ending in sclerotized spatulae
evidence.locator: 接受稿 p. 15–16，行 350–353，「Diagnosis」（正式版页码不同）
evidence.note: 支撑：两式工蚁肠瓣：三片或六片主垫末端硬化成铲状片——鉴别要点与工蚁节。

evidence.quote: This genus corresponds to the clade IV in this work and to the oblectatus and sulcifrons patterns in Josens & Deligne (2019); it includes Megagnathotermes katangensis.
evidence.locator: 接受稿 p. 16，行 360–362，「Comments」（正式版页码不同）
evidence.note: 支撑：对应 clade IV、oblectatus/sulcifrons 两型，并入原 Megagnathotermes katangensis——鉴别要点。

evidence.quote: Etymology. From Greek πολυς, polus, many; and σπαθος, spathos, spatula.
evidence.locator: 接受稿 p. 16，行 357–358，「Etymology」（正式版页码不同）
evidence.note: 支撑：属名 polys + spathos（多 + 铲）——中文名「多铲」的依据。

evidence.quote: Diagnosis. The workers within this genus have basic EVAs, with fusiform or roughly rectangular primary cushions

evidence.note: 支撑：蛇白蚁属（/genus/ophiotermes/）

evidence.quote: Front of head prolonged into a very large conspicuous nose; sides of head rounded. Proboscitermes. Front of head not prolonged into a nose; sides of head straight and parallel. Orthotermes .

evidence.quote: Head yellowish; rectangular; sides fairly straight and parallel. Antennae with 14 segments, the third longer than the second, the second equal to the fourth. evidence.quote: Head medium dark red-brown; fontanelle slit-shaped, light. Antennae with 15 segments, the third very small, the second equal to the fourth. Eyes of medium size. evidence.note: 支撑：原方白蚁属有翅成虫（M. niapuensis）

evidence.quote: Head reddish yellow; rectangular; sides straight and parallel; gula without sharp projection. evidence.note: 支撑：原方白蚁属兵蚁（M. undulans）

evidence.quote: Head yellowish brown; oval; fontanelle small, white; three muscle insertions in front of the fontanelle. The third segment of the antennae about twice as long as the second or fourth, showing signs of division. Eyes of medium size, close to the lower margin.

evidence.quote: Head rectangular, reddish yellow brown. Antennae with 19-21 segments. Labrum wide with hyaline tip. Mandibles black, the left coarsely dentate. evidence.note: 支撑：伪刺白蚁属有翅成虫（A. spiniger）

evidence.quote: For the present I am regarding Pseudacanthotermes as a subgenus. The genus as a whole seems to be successful in Rain Forests as well as in the Savanna. Large fungus gardens are found in the nests.

evidence.quote: Head yellow; strongly narrowed in front; sides fairly straight. Antennae with 14 segments, the third very long (.22-32 mm.), the second and fourth about equal. Labrum with a concave anterior margin ending in two sharp points. Mandibles long and slender, black, adapted for snapping.

evidence.quote: Head reddish yellow-brown with a darker nose; conspicuously constricted in the middle; two hairs on the vertex.

evidence.quote: The third segment is longer than the second or fourth but is not double the length of the second as in N. dorise. Mandibles with very small points which are barely distinguishable.
evidence.note: 支撑：缩狭白蚁属兵蚁触角与上颚点

evidence.quote: Head rectangular with rounded angles, only slightly narrowed in front; reddish yellow; covered with short hair. Antennae with 13 segments, the third smaller than the second, the second equal to the fourth. Labrum with rounded sides and a hyaline point.

evidence.quote: Head light brownish yellow; oval; fontanelle a round light dot and rather small; head covered with short hairs and a few long bristles. sources.title: A taxonomic revision of the neotropical termite genus Ruptitermes (Isoptera, Termitidae, Apicotermitinae)

evidence.quote: Imago: Head capsule rounded in dorsal view, short and broad, densely covered with short hairs and scattered bristles. Fontanelle variable, elliptical to rounded, usually conspicuous. Eyes relatively small; ocelli rounded or elliptical, distant from eyes by at least its diameter
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫头短宽而圆，囟多变，复眼较小、单眼距复眼至少其直径。

evidence.quote: Postclypeus relatively small and moderately inflated to large and inflated; depressed at both ends of the midline; midline conspicuous, depressed, and incomplete, vanishing near anterior and posterior margins.
evidence.note: 支撑：后唇基中线两端凹陷，中线明显、不完整。

evidence.quote: Antenna with 15 articles. Each tibia with two apical spurs. Wings uniformly covered with irregularly shaped micrasters, with 2–4 arms
evidence.note: 支撑：触角 15 节，各胫节 2 端距，翅面覆 2–4 臂微鳞。

evidence.quote: Head broad and rounded, usually well sclerotized and dark colored (pale colored in a few species); chaetotaxy variable. Fontanelle elliptical to rounded, small to large, of variable color, usually conspicuous. Postclypeus inflated or flattened.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁头宽圆、通常骨化深色深；囟多变；后唇基膨大或扁平。

evidence.quote: A pair of rounded, well-developed dehiscent glands present in the anterior part of abdomen, filling up to 1/3 of its volume.
evidence.note: 支撑：腹部前部具一对球形发达破裂腺，可达腹部体积 1/3。

evidence.quote: Enteric valve with bilateral symmetry, bearing 6 unsclerotized, reticulated ridges (3 longer ones on one side and 3 shorter ones on the other side); spines absent in most species.
evidence.note: 支撑：肠瓣两侧对称、6 条无骨化网纹脊，多数种无刺。

evidence.quote: The workers of Ruptitermes are easily recognized by the presence of the dehiscent glands, which are usually conspicuous as a whitish mass in the anterior part of the abdomen.
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁以腹部前部白色团块状的破裂腺易于识别。

evidence.quote: Imagoes are larger than most other neotropical Apicotermitinae. The imagoes of Aparatermes Fontes 1985 are the most similar and can be distinguished by the shape of the postclypeus, which is not depressed at the ends of the midline.
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫大于多数新热带 Apicotermitinae；与 Aparatermes 以后唇基中线两端不凹陷区分。

evidence.quote: Left mandible: A shorter than M1 (except in R. bandeirai , sp.n, where they are about the same length), M3 usually very short (except in R. arboreus and R. bandeirai , sp.n); notch between M1 and M3 always present
evidence.note: 支撑：工蚁左上颚端齿（A）短于第一缘齿（M1），M1–M3 之间恒有缺刻。

evidence.quote: Crop very small in most species (large only in R. arboreus ); gizzard unarmed
evidence.note: 支撑：多数种嗉囊很小，砂囊无武装。

evidence.note: 澳大利亚白蚁属（australitermes）：支撑：「有翅成虫」触角节数与比例、左颚指数及其在澳大利亚支系中的位置。

evidence.quote: Head with a small constriction visible from both the top and side. The profile of the pronotum has a sharp angle close to a right angle between the front lobe and the basal portion.
evidence.note: 澳大利亚白蚁属（australitermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」单型、头部小收缩与前胸背板侧轮廓的近直角。

evidence.quote: SOLDIER: The mandibles lack apical points.
evidence.note: 小锡兰白蚁属（ceylonitermellus）：支撑：「兵蚁」唯一可引性状。

evidence.quote: The left mandible has a characteristically long first plus second marginal tooth. The left mandible index is 0.62.
evidence.note: 小锡兰白蚁属（ceylonitermellus）：支撑：「工蚁」左颚第 1+2 缘齿特别长与指数 0.62。

evidence.quote: The third marginal tooth is proportionately small compared to that of Leucopitermes. The right mandible has a concave outline of the molar plate. The angles between the apical teeth and the first marginal teeth of both mandibles are wider than those of any other related genera in the Oriental region.
evidence.note: 小锡兰白蚁属（ceylonitermellus）：支撑：「工蚁」「鉴别要点」第 3 缘齿小、右颚磨板凹、端齿与第 1 缘齿夹角最宽。

evidence.quote: Minute hairs occur on the frontal tube and vertex that are not so long nor so abundant as in Malagasitermes milloti. A small but distinct constriction at the sides of the head behind the bases of the antennae is visible from above. The mandibles may be with or without points.
evidence.note: 白脸白蚁属（leucopitermes）：支撑「兵蚁」头毛被、缩窄、上颚有或无端尖。

evidence.quote: The mandibular index of the left mandible is 0.56. The notch in front of the third marginal tooth is wide but distinct. The third marginal tooth is proportionately rather wide. The right mandible has a distinct second marginal tooth, with a fairly sharp angle a little less than a right angle separating the first and second marginal teeth.
evidence.note: 白脸白蚁属（leucopitermes）：支撑「工蚁」左颚指数 0.56 及各缘齿/磨板形态。

evidence.quote: The index of the left mandible is 1.06. The second marginal tooth of the right mandible is almost completely regressed, and the outline of the molar plate is somewhat concave. The lack of a distinct third marginal tooth on the left mandible and the reduced second marginal tooth on the right mandible distinguish this genus from all others in the Subulitermes branch in the Oriental region.
evidence.note: 东锥白蚁属（oriensubulitermes）：支撑「工蚁/鉴别要点」左颚指数 1.06 与建属性状。

evidence.quote: The head has a distinct constriction and a rather bulbous rear portion. The frontal tube is conic. The antenna has 12-13 articles. The single soldier of Malagasitermes milloti examined has a distinct but short, sharp, apical point on the right mandible and no apical point on the left mandible.
evidence.note: 马尔加什白蚁属（malagasitermes）：支撑「兵蚁」头形、额突、触角、上颚端尖不对称。

evidence.quote: Both mandibles have proportionately large apical teeth compared to the first marginal teeth, and the cutting edge of the first plus second marginal tooth of the left mandible is undulated. A distinct notch is retained in front of the third marginal tooth of the left mandible. The right mandible has a somewhat rounded second marginal tooth. The mandibular index of the left mandible is 0.66.
evidence.note: 马尔加什白蚁属（malagasitermes）：支撑「工蚁」左颚指数 0.66 与各缘齿形态。

evidence.quote: Fontanelle distinctly forked at the anterior end. Postclypeus much longer than half of the width (length, 0.22 mm.; width, 0.32 mm.). The generic distinctions include the prominent second marginal tooth on the right mandible. The left mandible index is 0.68.
evidence.note: 隐白蚁属（occultitermes）：支撑「有翅成虫」囟分叉、后唇基长宽比、左颚指数 0.68。

evidence.quote: SOLDIER: Dimorphic. The mandibles are without points.
evidence.note: 隐白蚁属（occultitermes）：支撑「兵蚁/鉴别要点」二型兵蚁、上颚无端尖。

evidence.quote: The left mandible index is 1.07 in Macrosubulitermes greavesi and 1.29-1.33 in Subulitermes microsoma.
evidence.note: 大锥白蚁属（macrosubulitermes）：支撑「有翅成虫」左颚指数 1.07。

evidence.quote: The head length divided by the head width is 1.49-1.63 in Macrosubulitermes perlevis, 1.71 in M. greavesi, and 2.27 in Subulitermes microsoma. The head of Macrosubulitermes greavesi is very slightly constricted, with lateral humps just posterior to the base of the frontal projection. The mandibles are without points in both Macrosubulitermes and Subulitermes.
evidence.note: 大锥白蚁属（macrosubulitermes）：支撑「兵蚁」头长宽比、微缩窄、上颚无端尖。

sources.title: Termites collected on the Mulford Biological Exploration to the Amazon Basin, 1921-1922
sources.journal: Proceedings of the United States National Museum 68
sources.notes: Agnathotermes 作为 Nasutitermes 亚属首次发表处（pp. 41-42）；文章起止页未能从 OCR 页眉确认，引用页为印刷页码。OCR 把 subgenera 断作 sub genera，故引文自 mandibles without points 起。

evidence.quote: mandibles without points, nasus short and conical as in the subgenus Convexitermes Holmgren. Antenna with 11-12 segments.
evidence.note: 无颚白蚁属（agnathotermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」上颚无端尖、鼻短圆锥形、触角 11-12 节。

sources.title: The Termites of Kartabo, Bartica District, British Guiana
sources.notes: Angularitermes 作为 Nasutitermes 亚属的原始描述（p. 419）。OCR 把 elevation 断作 eleva tion，引文止于该词之前。

evidence.quote: Head yellow brown, constricted behind the antennae; thickly covered with bristles. Antennae same color as the head, with 14 segments, the 3d one and one- half times the length of the 2d, the 4th equals the 3d or is very slightly longer. Mandibles with long points, the left with a very small microscopical tooth near the base, the right without a tooth near the base.
evidence.note: 棱角白蚁属（angularitermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」头色、触角后收缩、刚毛、触角节数与比例、上颚长端尖及基部齿的有无。

evidence.quote: Nose darker than the head, very thickly covered with short hairs from the constriction in the head to the tip; very large, long, and thick at the base. This is the most extreme case of the development of the nose among all the nasuate soldiers known to me.
evidence.note: 棱角白蚁属（angularitermes）：支撑：「鉴别要点」「兵蚁」鼻的大小与毛被，以及原作者对其发达程度的判断。

evidence.quote: Head dark brown, sparsely clothed with long hairs; oval, posterior margin behind the eyes angular from above
evidence.note: 棱角白蚁属（angularitermes）：支撑：「有翅成虫」头色、毛被、卵形轮廓与眼后棱角状后缘。
evidence.ocr_note: OCR 把该句后半 split 作 eleva tion，引文止于可确读处。

evidence.quote: Cavitermes seems to be nearest to Mirotermes, s. str. than to any other subgenus but it differs from the typical Mirotermes, s. str. in the ridges along the forehead of the soldier and the hollowed front which suggested the name.
evidence.note: 支撑：腔白蚁属（/genus/cavitermes/）

evidence.quote: The mandibles of the soldier are similar in shape and adaptation to those of Mirotermes, s. str.
evidence.note: 支撑：腔白蚁属（/genus/cavitermes/）

evidence.quote: The soldier is quite distinct from all the other groups of the genus Mirotermes in that it has a flat forehead. With this exception, I believe it comes closest to the subgenus Mirotermes, s. str. The mandibles are adapted for snapping and have the same form as in Mirotermes, s. str.
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁额部平坦、弹射式上颚

evidence.quote: Head brown, widely oval, covered with short hair and bristles . . . Fontanelle a little darker than the rest of the head, inconspicuous. Left mandible with 2 large teeth, one sharply pointed, the other rounded; right mandible with only 1 pointed tooth. The 3d segment of the antennae very short, much shorter than the 4th
evidence.note: 支撑：有翅成虫头形、颚齿、触角第3节

evidence.quote: Head pale yellow, covered with short hairs; long, subrectangular, sides nearly parallel, converging sharply in front of the base of the antennae. Antennae paler than the head, with 13 segments . . . Labrum with 2 points . . . Mandibles brown, slender, extreme end sharply curved, base broad with a tooth on the inner edge . . . Pronotum paler than the head, saddle-shaped
evidence.note: 支撑：兵蚁头形、触角、上唇、上颚、前胸背板

evidence.quote: I take pleasure in naming the species in honor of Mr. John Tee-Van, who collected the only specimens of winged imagos and who helped me in many other ways in my work on termites at Kartabo.
evidence.note: 支撑：teevani 纪念 John Tee-Van

sources.title: Atlantitermes, novo gênero de cupim, com duas novas espécies do Brasil (Isoptera, Termitidae, Nasutitermitinae)
sources.notes: Atlantitermes 原始属级描述。葡萄牙文，OCR 有 Mj+2、<luase 等讹字；只引可确读的完整句子，未作改写。

evidence.quote: Imago. Cabeça e pronoto com muitos pêlos e umas poucas cerdas longas (figs. 1 - 6). Fontanela alongada, extremidade anterior bifurcada. Olhos grandes. Ocelos mais próximos dos respectivos olhos do que a largura de cada ocelo. Pós-clípeo mais curto do que a metade de sua largura.
evidence.note: 阿特拉斯白蚁属（atlantitermes）：支撑：「有翅成虫」毛被、囟形、眼与单眼、后唇基比例。

evidence.quote: Soldado. Cabeça com pêlos minúsculos, esparsos, e umas poucas cerdas longas (figs. 12 - 15); naso com inúmeros pelos curtos. Cabeça, dorsal (figs. 12 - 13): adelgaçada logo atrás da inserção das antenas, região posterior bulbosa, naso cônico; perfil (figs. 14 - 15): naso também cônico. Mandíbulas sem pontas.
evidence.note: 阿特拉斯白蚁属（atlantitermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」头与鼻的毛被、头壳在触角后变细且后部球状、鼻锥形、上颚无端尖。

evidence.quote: Mandíbulas (figs. 10 - 11, um pouco desgastadas) semelhantes às do alado, mas mandíbula esquerda com margem cortante entre M1+2 e M3 distintamente sinuosa.
evidence.note: 阿特拉斯白蚁属（atlantitermes）：支撑：「工蚁」「鉴别要点」工蚁上颚与有翅成虫相似而左颚切缘明显波状。

sources.title: Caetetermes taquarussu, a new genus and species of Ecuadorian nasute (Isoptera, Termitidae, Nasutitermitinae)
sources.notes: Caetetermes 原始属级描述（Imago. Unknown）；工蚁一节据原文对大型工蚁（major worker）的描述。

evidence.quote: Head capsule sharply constricted (figs. 1-4) behind antennae, posterior region bulbous. Nose long, cylindrical and not specially enlarged at base. Postclypeus oblique, clearly visible in dorsal view (figs. 1-2). Mandibles (figs. 5-6) without points, with a distinct but not sharply defined thinner patch of cuticle at the apex.
evidence.note: 林白蚁属（caetetermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」头壳急剧收缩与后部球状、鼻形、后唇基与上颚端部构造。

evidence.quote: Width of postclypeus/length of postclypeus 3.66-4.89. Left mandible (figs. 9, 12): index 0.49; A shorter than Ml + 2; posterior margin of A almost straight and shorter than the anterior margin of Ml+2; angle, between A and Ml+2 acute; cutting edge of Ml+2 sinuate, separated from M3 by a sharp notch; M3 developed, posterior margin convex;
evidence.note: 林白蚁属（caetetermes）：支撑：「工蚁」后唇基比例、左颚指数、端齿与 M1+2、M3 的关系。
evidence.ocr_note: OCR 把 M1+2 印作 Ml + 2，引文照录。

evidence.quote: Legs long but shorter than the corresponding soldier legs; anterior coxae with a weak hump outside corresponding to the prominent soldier hump
evidence.note: 林白蚁属（caetetermes）：支撑：「工蚁」「鉴别要点」足长与前足基节外侧隆起。

sources.title: A new genus and species of Nasutitermitinae from South America (Isoptera, Termitidae)
sources.notes: Coendutermes 原始属级描述（Alate. Unknown）。

evidence.quote: Head capsule with many hollow glandular bristles scattered over dorsum and sides (figs. 1-2). These are large and well visible erect bristles, brownish in colour and stout, ending in a truncated tip. Non-glandular bristles are apparently absent in the head, except for the apex of the nose.
evidence.note: 箭猪白蚁属（coendutermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」「鉴别要点」腺刚毛形态与「除鼻端外无普通刚毛」。

evidence.quote: Nose conical, slightly turned upwards; tip pointed. Postclypeus weakly oblique, visible in dorsal view. Mandibles each with a discrete hump on apex but without a developed apical point. Antenna (fig. 2) very long, extending well beyond the apex of the nose.
evidence.note: 箭猪白蚁属（coendutermes）：支撑：「兵蚁」鼻形、后唇基、上颚端部突起、触角长度。

evidence.quote: Worker. Apparently monomorphic. Abdominal sclerites pale coloured or incolor, transparent, with gut contents clearly showing through. Remainder of body sclerites whitish to yellowish. Glandular bristles absent. Head with a few long bristles and many moderately long bristles (figs. 4-5). Postclypeus moderately inflated. Width of postclypeus/length of postclypeus 2.90-3.25.
evidence.note: 箭猪白蚁属（coendutermes）：支撑：「工蚁」单型、腹部骨片透明、无腺刚毛、头毛被与后唇基比例。

sources.notes: 属级比较（非单属原始描述）：用于 Agnathotermes、Araujotermes、Coatitermes 的工蚁颚齿与工蚁宽隙/窄隙形态。

evidence.quote: markedly wider in Atlantitermes and Araujotermes
evidence.note: 阿劳若白蚁属（araujotermes）：支撑：「工蚁」「鉴别要点」宽隙型裂隙明显更宽。

evidence.quote: weakly or not sinuate in Coatitermes (fig. 31)
evidence.note: 凸鼻白蚁属（coatitermes）：支撑：「工蚁」窄隙型切缘弱波状或不波状。

sources.title: Anhangatermes macarthuri, a New Genus and Species of Soil-feeding Nasute Termite from Amapá, Brazil (Isoptera, Termitidae, Nasutitermitinae)
sources.notes: Anhangatermes 原始属级描述（IMAGO - Unknown）。该 PDF 每页页脚插在正文行间，引文避开页脚或另注。

evidence.quote: Head capsule broad and rounded. Nasus conico-cylindrical, long and slender. Labrum short, not visible from dorsal view. Vestigial mandibles without points. Antenna with 13 segments, extending a little beyond tip of nasus. Width of pronotum approximately half the width of the head.
evidence.note: 魔白蚁属（anhangatermes）：支撑：「鉴别要点」「兵蚁」的头壳、鼻形、上唇、触角节数与前胸背板宽度。

evidence.quote: Monomorphic. Head capsule rounded, widest anteriorly. Postclypeus moderately inflated. Antenna with 14 segments. Head with few bristles. Apical tooth of mandibles well developed with inner margin concave.
evidence.note: 魔白蚁属（anhangatermes）：支撑：「工蚁」单型、头形、后唇基、触角 14 节与上颚端齿。

evidence.quote: molar prominence large and rounded, without ridges. Right mandible: third marginal tooth vestigial, almost absent; molar plate concave.
evidence.note: 魔白蚁属（anhangatermes）：支撑：「工蚁」左颚无脊的大磨突与右颚退化的第 3 缘齿、凹磨板。

evidence.quote: The harvester termite, Baucaliotermes hainesi (Fuller) (Termitidae: Nasutitermitinae), is an endemic in southern Namibia, where it collects and eats dry grass.
evidence.note: 支撑：纳米比亚南部特有种、取食干草

evidence.quote: The range of this species is limited to southern Namibia and the northwestern Cape Province of South Africa (Coaton and Sheasby 1973).
evidence.note: 支撑：分布限纳米比亚南部与南非西北开普省

evidence.quote: Nests of B. hainesi were regularly visible at the surface as small mounds of cemented material 10 to 15 cm high.
evidence.note: 支撑：巢在地表露出 10–15 cm 高胶结砂小丘

evidence.quote: At 50 to 75 cm intervals, the tunnels are connected to the surface by vertical risers that can be opened to gain foraging access to the surrounding area.
evidence.note: 支撑：每 50–75 cm 一条通往地面的竖井

evidence.quote: Riser openings were usually closed during the day, as this termite species forages mostly at night.
evidence.note: 支撑：竖井白天关闭、主要夜间觅食

evidence.quote: The distance between risers averaged 50 to 75 cm among tunnels (SD 14 to 40 cm), suggesting that the termites rarely needed to travel more than one half to one meter on the surface.
evidence.note: 支撑：竖井间距 50–75 cm（SD 14–40），地面行走很少超过 0.5–1 m

evidence.quote: The total length of tunnels exposed was 76 m within an area of roughly 170 m2 in the first excavation and 110 m of tunnel in an area of about 300 m2 in the second excavation.
evidence.note: 支撑：两次发掘分别为 76 m/170 m² 与 110 m/300 m²

evidence.quote: In the center runs a smooth, raised walkway along which termites travel, and along the sides lie pockets that act as depots where foragers deposit grass pieces harvested from the surface.
evidence.note: 支撑：隧道中央走道、两侧凹囊为草片段暂存点

evidence.quote: The nest was home to about 45,000 termites, of which about 6,000 (13%) were immature (but very small immatures, and eggs were not counted), 32,300 (71%; 36 g, dry) were workers and 4,100 (9.1%; 3 g, dry) were soldiers.
In addition, there were about 2,800 (6.2%; 5 g, dry) immature reproductives with wing buds.
evidence.note: 支撑：具翅芽未成熟生殖蚁约 2,800 头（6.2%）

evidence.quote: No primary reproductives and no “royal cell” were found, suggesting this may have been a subsidiary nest (or calie).
evidence.note: 支撑：未见原始生殖蚁与王台，疑为副巢

evidence.quote: The total dry weight of grass in the nest was about 15 g, probably a small fraction of what was still in the tunnel system depots.
evidence.note: 支撑：巢内草片段干重约 15 g

evidence.quote: A species of smaller termite, Promirotermes sp., was found co-nesting with B. hainesi.
evidence.note: 支撑：同巢外壳内有 Promirotermes sp. 共栖

evidence.quote: Sixty-nine randomly located, circular quadrats were sampled to study the selection of wood by Heterotcrmcs aurens (Snyder), Gnathamitermes per plexus (Banks), Paraneotermes shnplicicomis (Banks) and 3 species of Amitermes.

evidence.quote: Although H. aureus and G. perplextts are general feeders on ca. 13 species of wood, the former prefers dead wood of desert hackberry and cholla cactus, while the latter prefers fallen cholla joints.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：H. aureus 取食约 13 种木材，偏好荒漠朴与 cholla 仙人掌枯段。

evidence.quote: The other two termites have more specific tastes: P. simplicicornis prefers catclaw acacia and mesquite and cholla stumps while the Amitermes spp. select catclaw acacia and blue palo-verde.

evidence.quote: Each termite species thus maintains a fairly exclusive niche through a characteristic mode of attack on a preferential selection of host woods.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：各白蚁种通过偏好寄主木材与特征性攻击方式维持较独立的生态位。

sources.notes: 全文存于 _unpublished/文库/10.1186-s12864-023-09224-5（83169 字符），抽取：xml-text；文本由 PDF/XML 抽取，不是排版原貌：上标引文编号、表格、图注可能错位，正式引用前须核对出版方原文；OA 全文自动归档（europepmc XML）；全文只存本地文库供检索，不发布、不对外分发。标题/作者/年份取自开放元数据，引用以出版方原文为准。

evidence.quote: We showed that the Labiotermes gut was dominated by members of the Firmicutes phylum, whose abundance gradually decreased towards the posterior segments of the hindgut, in favour of Bacteroidetes, Proteobacteria and Verrucomicrobia.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：肠道以厚壁菌门为主，向后肠逐渐减少，拟杆菌门、变形菌门与疣微菌门增加。

evidence.quote: Contrary to expectations, we observed that L. labralis gut microbes expressed a high diversity of carbohydrate active enzymes involved in cellulose and hemicelluloses degradation, making the soil-feeding termite gut a unique reservoir of lignocellulolytic enzymes with considerable biotechnological potential.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：肠道微生物表达大量降解纤维素与半纤维素的碳水化合物活性酶。

evidence.quote: We also evidenced that the host cellulases have different phylogenetic origins and structures, which is possibly translated into their different specificities towards cellulose.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：宿主自身的纤维素酶在系统发育来源与结构上各不相同。

evidence.quote: Labiotermes labralis (L. labralis; Termitidae, Syntermitinae) is one of the most abundant soil feeders in the Amazonian primary forest [13], playing a fundamental role in soil structure and fertility [14].
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：细唇厚唇白蚁是亚马逊原始林最常见的土食者之一。

evidence.quote: The digestive tract of an L. labralis worker is highly compartmentalised, which is a characteristic of all soil feeders, and it includes the foregut (F, crop and gizzard), the midgut (M, mesenteron) and the hindgut (H), which is further differentiated into P1 (paunch), P2 (enteric valve), dilated P3 and P4 (colon), as well as P5 (rectum; Fig. 1A) [15].
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：该种工蚁消化道高度分室化（前肠、中肠、后肠 P1–P5）。

sources.title: Abundance and diversity of termites in a savanna woodland reserve in tropical Australia
sources.notes: 全文存于 _unpublished/文库/10.1111-j.1440-6055.2008.00662.x（2120 字符），抽取：text；文本由 PDF/XML 抽取，不是排版原貌：上标引文编号、表格、图注可能错位，正式引用前须核对出版方原文；无 OA 全文，仅存完整摘要（2119 字，abstract_source=openalex）。摘要全文存于本地文库供检索，不发布、不对外分发；引用以出版方原文为准。

evidence.quote: Termite species diversity, frequency of occurrence and functional diversity in Charles Darwin National Park, a savanna woodland reserve in tropical northern Australia, were assessed. In four 50 × 50 m sites, a direct search and bait sampling protocol was used to sample mounds, standing and lying dead wood, litter, soil and arboreal nest microhabitats for termites between April and June 2003.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：查尔斯·达尔文国家公园 4 个 50×50 m 样地、2003 年 4–6 月采样。

evidence.quote: Sixteen species from nine genera and three families (Mastotermitidae, Rhinotermitidae and Termitidae) were recorded, including the first record of Ephelotermes taylori (Hill) from open savanna woodland habitat and the first official record of Macrognathotermes errator Miller from north Australian savanna.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：记录 16 种、9 属、3 科；E. taylori 为开阔稀树草原生境首次记录，M. errator 为北澳稀树草原首次正式记录。

evidence.quote: The family Termitidae represented 69% of termite occurrences. From this family, the wood/soil interface feeder Nasutitermes eucalypti (Mjöberg) represented 30% of encounters.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：白蚁科占出现次数 69%，其中木质/土壤交界取食的 N. eucalypti 占全部遭遇的 30%。

evidence.quote: Four nesting habits were represented: epigeal (mounds above ground), hypogeal (subterranean nests), nests within wood and arboreal nests. Termites were most frequently encountered in epigeal mounds and lying dead wood.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：记录 4 种筑巢方式；白蚁最常出现于地上蚁丘与倒木。

evidence.quote: However, species diversity was lower; soil feeders and live wood feeders were less common and grass‐harvesting species were absent.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：土壤取食者与活木取食者较少、采草种类缺失，多样性较低。

evidence.quote: Soil nitrogen and phosphorus and species richness and patchiness of ground vegetation may contribute to these differences.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：作者把差异部分归因于土壤氮磷含量与地表植被的丰富度和斑块性。

sources.title: La Sociotomie: Migration Et Fragmentation De La Termitière Chez Les Anoplotermes Et Les Trinervitermes
sources.notes: 全文存于 _unpublished/文库/10.1163-156853951x00241（2110 字符），抽取：text；文本由 PDF/XML 抽取，不是排版原貌：上标引文编号、表格、图注可能错位，正式引用前须核对出版方原文；无 OA 全文，仅存完整摘要（2109 字，abstract_source=openalex）。摘要全文存于本地文库供检索，不发布、不对外分发；引用以出版方原文为准。

evidence.quote: Under the term of sociotomy, (or fission of the society) we describe a curious social behaviour of two African Termites: Anoplotermes sp. and Trinervitermes bettonianus.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：把两种非洲白蚁（Anoplotermes sp. 与 T. bettonianus）的群体分裂称为 sociotomy。

evidence.quote: Crowded columns, one including the royal couple, emerge in broad daylight and crawl away to various distances. They represent only a small part of the society to which they belong.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：队伍在白天离巢、含王室配偶，且只占原群体的一小部分。

evidence.quote: After having covered a greater or lesser distance, each column breaks into several portions, each of which remains alone, scoops out (Anoplotermes) or builds (Trinervitermes) a nest which becomes the foundation of a new society.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：每列分裂为若干小群，各自挖出（Anoplotermes）或建造（Trinervitermes）新巢作为新群体起点。

evidence.quote: Substitution reproductives are obtained by means of neoteny which is very frequent in the two species in which sociotomy has been observed. All the castes are represented in the migration, including the functional reproductives and the winged individuals.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：补充生殖蚁通过幼态持续频繁产生；迁徙队伍涵盖所有品级包括具功能生殖蚁与有翅个体。

evidence.quote: The winged individuals, which normally only issue from the nest to undertake their swarming flight have their genetic behaviour abolished and can be seen creeping on the surface of the ground carrying larvae. The Anoplotermes workers can even acquire the behaviour of soldiers.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：有翅个体在地面爬行并搬运幼虫；解甲白蚁属工蚁甚至表现出兵蚁行为。

evidence.quote: For the first time, the usefulness of the nasuti in defending the nest is firmly established, and so is the importance of the organization of the group in the defence against the assailants.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：作者首次以确凿观察确认象鼻兵蚁（nasuti）在防御中的作用。
