sources.title: About custom domains and GitHub Pages

evidence.quote: If you configure the correct records for each domain type through your DNS provider, GitHub Pages will automatically create redirects between the domains. For example, if you configure www.example.com as the custom domain for your site, and you have GitHub Pages DNS records set up for the apex and www domains, then example.com will redirect to www.example.com.
evidence.locator: Using an apex domain for your GitHub Pages site ¶3
evidence.note: 支撑：apex 与 www 之间由 GitHub 自动 301；文档未承诺 user.github.io/repo/ 会 301 到自定义域名，故迁移前须实测

evidence.quote: You can set up either or both of apex and www subdomain configurations for your site.
evidence.note: 支撑：自定义域名支持 apex / www / 自定义子域三种形态

sources.title: 了解站点地图 (What is a sitemap)

evidence.quote: 站点地图可帮助搜索引擎发现网站上的网址，但并不保证 Google 能抓取站点地图中的所有内容并将其编入索引。但在大多数情况下，您的网站都会因使用站点地图而受益。
evidence.note: 支撑：sitemap 已读 ≠ 已收录；评估里「sitemap 状态与收录状态是两回事」的判断依据

evidence.quote: 网站为新网站且指向该网站的外部链接不多。Googlebot 及其他网页抓取工具通过访问之前抓取过的网页中找到的网址来抓取网页。因此，如果没有其他网站链接到您的网页，Googlebot 可能发现不了您的网页。
evidence.locator: §我需要站点地图吗？ 列表项 2
evidence.note: 支撑：新站 + 无外链时发现慢是常态，不能归因于域名

sources.title: Managing a custom domain for your GitHub Pages site

evidence.quote: Make sure you add your custom domain to your GitHub Pages site before configuring your custom domain with your DNS provider. Configuring your custom domain with your DNS provider without adding your custom domain to GitHub could result in someone else being able to host a site on one of your subdomains.
evidence.note: 支撑：操作顺序必须是「先在 Settings → Pages 填域名，再去 Cloudflare 建记录」

evidence.quote: If you are publishing from a custom GitHub Actions workflow, no `CNAME` file is created, and any existing `CNAME` file is ignored and is not required.
evidence.note: 支撑：本站走自定义 Actions 发布，不需要、也不应添加 CNAME 文件

evidence.locator: § DNS records for your custom domain，表格「Apex domain / A」行
evidence.note: 支撑：apex 的 4 条 A 记录值

evidence.locator: § DNS records for your custom domain，表格「Apex domain / AAAA」行
evidence.note: 支撑：apex 的 4 条 AAAA 记录值

evidence.quote: Ensure that the `CNAME` record points directly to `<user>.github.io` or `<organization>.github.io` without including the repository name.
evidence.locator: § Configuring an apex domain and the `www` subdomain variant，¶3
evidence.note: 支撑：www 的 CNAME 指向 bennetgreen-bilibili.github.io，不带仓库名

evidence.quote: Optionally, to enforce HTTPS encryption for your site, select **Enforce HTTPS**. It can take up to 24 hours before this option is available.
evidence.note: 支撑：Enforce HTTPS 可能要等 24 小时才出现

sources.title: Troubleshooting custom domains and GitHub Pages

evidence.quote: If you are publishing from a custom GitHub Actions workflow, any CNAME file is ignored and is not required.
evidence.note: 支撑：CNAME 文件在本站发布方式下无效，社区常见建议对本站不适用

evidence.quote: It can take up to an hour for your site to become available over HTTPS after you configure your custom domain. After you update existing DNS settings, you may need to remove and re-add your custom domain to your site's repository to trigger the process of enabling HTTPS.
evidence.note: 支撑：证书签发失败时的处置办法（Remove 再 Save 重启签发）

evidence.quote: If you're using Certification Authority Authorization (CAA) records, at least one CAA record must exist with the value `letsencrypt.org` for your site to be accessible over HTTPS.
evidence.note: 支撑：若 Cloudflare 建了 CAA 记录，必须放行 letsencrypt.org

sources.title: Securing your GitHub Pages site with HTTPS

evidence.quote: Any additional `A`, `AAAA`, `ALIAS`, `ANAME` records with the `@` host, or `CNAME` records pointing to your `www` subdomain or other custom subdomain that you would like to use with GitHub Pages may prevent the HTTPS certificate from generating.
evidence.note: 支撑：apex 上不能有多余记录（Cloudflare 建站时可能自动生成），否则证书签不出来

evidence.quote: If the process has not completed several minutes after you clicked **Save**, try clicking **Remove** next to your custom domain name. Retype the domain name and click **Save** again. This will cancel and restart the provisioning process.
evidence.locator: § Troubleshooting certificate provisioning ("Certificate not yet created" error)，¶2
evidence.note: 支撑：域名已正确解析但证书迟迟不出时的重试操作

evidence.quote: the entire domain name of your GitHub Pages site must be less than 64 characters long for a certificate to be successfully created.
evidence.note: 支撑：termite-extant-isoptera.org 共 28 字符，满足证书长度要求

sources.title: Amitermes californicus Banks, 1920 (Isoptera, Termitidae, Termitinae) resurrected after ninety years of synonymy and A. floridensis Scheffrahn, 1989 synonymized into A. wheeleri (Desneux, 1906)
sources.notes: 全文存于 _unpublished/文库/Amitermes-californicus-Banks,-1920-(Isoptera,-Termitidae,-Termitinae)-resurrecte（8 页，20801 字符），抽取：pdf-text；文本由 PDF/XML 抽取，不是排版原貌：上标引文编号、表格、图注可能错位，正式引用前须核对出版方原文。

evidence.quote:
Without discussion, Light (1931, 1932) synonymized A. californicus with A. wheeleri and this
synonymy has gone unchallenged until now.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：Light 在 1931、1932 年未作讨论地把 A. californicus 并入 A. wheeleri，此后九十年无人质疑。

evidence.quote:
About ten years ago, I reviewed Amitermes soldiers that I and colleagues had collected in California, Arizona, New
Mexico, and Texas over a period of 30 years. It became evident that there were two discernible species both having
robust anterior faces on the marginal teeth of the mandibles.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：复查三十年间采自加州、亚利桑那、新墨西哥与得克萨斯的兵蚁，确认其中有两个可区分的种。

evidence.quote:
those whose teeth are directed posterior and lack a well-defined anterior face (e.g., A.
emersoni Light). The former group includes A. wheeleri (Desneux), A. excellens Silvestri, A. brevicorniger Silvestri,
A. amifer Silvestri, and A. foreli Wasmann.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：缘齿垂直伸出、具前斜面一组包括 A. wheeleri、A. excellens、A. amifer、A. foreli；缘齿后倾、无前斜面者如 A. emersoni。

evidence.quote:
Amitermes floridensis
Scheffrahn, 1989 is now a synonym of A. wheeleri. The establishment of A. wheeleri (=floridensis) in Florida is suggested
to be the result of the ornamental palm trade from the southwestern United States. New collection records show that A.
wheeleri has not been found in California.
evidence.note: 支撑草稿：A. floridensis 降为 A. wheeleri 次异名；佛州种群被认为随观赏棕榈贸易自美国西南部引入；新记录显示 A. wheeleri 未在加州采到。
